As a foreign national living in the US, I am sure they know things about me that I don't know myself. I have zero expectation of privacy. My laptop and phone could be transmitting the sound in my room right now. Everything I download or upload through the internet is stored and associated with me.

I don't think there can be a good technological solution for privacy at the moment, no matter how clever it is, they can be a step ahead, because they have access to the manufacturers of every bit of tech out there.

The only solution to all of this is political. We need congressmen who care about privacy. And this will only happen through mass awareness. However, realizing the importance of privacy (and the dangers of the lack thereof) requires an amount of intelligence and foresight that most people lack, therefore I don't see any fundamental solutions to this problem in the next decade. I hope I am wrong.
